name: vscode-guitar-dsl
description: Guitar rhythm slash notation and tab score previewer for guitarDSL

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_validate_dsl
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Validate a GuitarDSL (.guitardsl/.gdsl) score with the extension's own parser and return its diagnostics as JSON (valid, errorCount, warningCount, diagnostics with 1-based line/startColumn/endColumn). Read-only. Call it after creating or materially editing GuitarDSL. Without path the target is the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible GuitarDSL editor, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document (the extension's command resolution order). New/create-song workflow: establish the new GuitarDSL document first and pass its path (or, for a new untitled document that is active, keep this result's document.uri); do not use the fallback resolution to select an existing score as the destination of the new song.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document. If omitted, the target is the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible GuitarDSL editor, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document (the extension's command resolution order).

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_analyze_playability
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze capo playability of a GuitarDSL score with the extension's deterministic capo inference: returns sourceCapo, currentPlayability, recommendedCapo and one candidate per capo 0..12 (supported, score, level, reason). Read-only. Use it instead of estimating chord difficulty yourself. Without path the target is the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible GuitarDSL editor, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document (the extension's command resolution order).

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document. If omitted, the target is the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible GuitarDSL editor, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document (the extension's command resolution order).

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_apply_capo
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change the capo of a GuitarDSL score to targetCapo (0..12) while keeping the sounding harmony; the extension rewrites the capo header and chord names from the latest source in one undoable edit. Returns an operation summary and postValidationPassed, never the whole score. Fails without editing when a chord cannot be moved. Requires exactly one of uri or path identifying the document to edit; it never falls back to the active editor, and the user confirms that exact document. To edit the file the user is working on, first call guitardsl_validate_dsl without arguments and pass its result document.uri (this also works for unsaved untitled documents).

uri.description: Document URI of the GuitarDSL document to edit, for example document.uri from a guitardsl_validate_dsl result (file:///… or untitled:…). Pass exactly one of uri or path.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document to edit. Pass exactly one of uri or path.

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_apply_beginner_mode
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply Beginner Mode to a GuitarDSL score: the extension chooses an easy capo and simpler chord voicings that keep the sounding harmony, and rewrites the latest source in one undoable edit. barrePolicy allow/forbid controls barre chords; omit targetCapo for the automatic recommendation. Returns an operation summary and postValidationPassed. Requires exactly one of uri or path identifying the document to edit; it never falls back to the active editor, and the user confirms that exact document. To edit the file the user is working on, first call guitardsl_validate_dsl without arguments and pass its result document.uri (this also works for unsaved untitled documents).

uri.description: Document URI of the GuitarDSL document to edit, for example document.uri from a guitardsl_validate_dsl result (file:///… or untitled:…). Pass exactly one of uri or path.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document to edit. Pass exactly one of uri or path.

barrePolicy.description: Whether barre chords may be used.

targetCapo.description: Capo fret to use. Omit for the automatic recommendation.

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_apply_transpose
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Transpose the sounding music (key, chords, melody) of a GuitarDSL score by semitones (-11..11) and choose the capo afterwards: keep the current capo, use the recommended capo, or an explicit capo (capo is required only for capoMode explicit). The extension rewrites the latest source in one undoable edit and returns an operation summary and postValidationPassed. Requires exactly one of uri or path identifying the document to edit; it never falls back to the active editor, and the user confirms that exact document. To edit the file the user is working on, first call guitardsl_validate_dsl without arguments and pass its result document.uri (this also works for unsaved untitled documents).

uri.description: Document URI of the GuitarDSL document to edit, for example document.uri from a guitardsl_validate_dsl result (file:///… or untitled:…). Pass exactly one of uri or path.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document to edit. Pass exactly one of uri or path.

capo.description: Capo fret; required only when capoMode is 'explicit'.

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_analyze_accompaniment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Analyze the accompaniment of a GuitarDSL score before arranging it; returns JSON only, read-only. Without sectionIndex: every section (0-based sectionIndex in source order, name, meters, feels, current rhythm families, canonical preset matches, up to 5 adaptation candidates, availableFamilies), the section transition contexts and the ending context (vocal timing from mel:/lyr:). With sectionIndex: that section only; add family to list that family's compatible canonical presets (metadata, no full catalog). The tool never guesses genre or mood; you choose the musical intent. Without path the target is the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible GuitarDSL editor, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document; pass the result's document.uri to guitardsl_apply_accompaniment. New score: when creating a new song, first write a structural draft (sections, chords, optional mel:/lyr:, no accompaniment rhythm), run guitardsl_validate_dsl, then analyze before apply; the extension generates the D/U strokes, they are not handwritten by the model. Analyze the already-created new target explicitly (its path); do not search for another open score. For a general arrangement/new-song request, call whole-score analysis once; do not request sectionIndex+family merely to browse presets; use that form only when a family is specifically needed.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document. Omit to use the active editor's GuitarDSL document, else a visible one, else the last active or any open GuitarDSL document.

sectionIndex.description: 0-based section index; omit for the whole score structure.

family.description: With sectionIndex: list this family's presets compatible with the section's meter and feel.

languageModelTools.name: guitardsl_apply_accompaniment
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply guitar accompaniment rhythms to sections of a GuitarDSL score. You decide the musical intent per section; the extension guarantees meter length, the physical down/up phase, syncopation, chord articulation (every chord gets a harmonic attack), phrase-end variations from the canonical catalog, and a source-preserving edit of rhythm tokens only (chords, lyrics, melody, comments, % repeats and barlines are kept). Optional transitions (max 3 ordered candidates per section boundary) and ending (max 3 ordered candidates for the final 1-2 measures) are checked against vocal timing and chords; the first legal candidate wins and nothing else is invented. All plans are validated before editing; any failure edits nothing. One invocation = one undoable edit. Returns a summary (selected presets, rationale, warnings, postValidationPassed), never the whole score. Requires exactly one of uri or path; it never falls back to the active editor. Call guitardsl_analyze_accompaniment first and guitardsl_validate_dsl afterwards. New score: when creating a new song, apply to the validated structural draft (no accompaniment rhythm) after analyze, in one call for all planned sections; the extension generates the D/U strokes, they are not handwritten by the model. If this tool fails, do not hand-write the rhythm instead. For new-song creation, this target must be the same new document used by validation/analyze. For general intent plans, prefer subdivision auto and omit optional constraints / preferences not requested by the user (hard constraints: family, fixed subdivision, syncopationKinds, difficulty; soft preference: preferredPresetId); the extension selects the canonical preset.

uri.description: Document URI of the GuitarDSL document to edit, for example document.uri from a guitardsl_analyze_accompaniment result (file:///… or untitled:…). Pass exactly one of uri or path.

path.description: Absolute file path of the GuitarDSL document to edit. Pass exactly one of uri or path.

items.description: One section plan. mode intent: the extension picks a canonical preset deterministically (operation replace changes the family; adapt keeps family/style/subdivision and only moves energy/density/syncopation/emphasis/difficulty, failing noCompatibleAdaptation instead of replacing). mode preset: exact catalog preset. mode grid: attack positions only. mode dsl: an explicit GuitarDSL rhythm pattern for one full measure, validated for meter length and (directionPolicy physical, the default) the physical down/up phase.

sectionIndex.description: 0-based section index in source order, from guitardsl_analyze_accompaniment (measures before the first [label] form section 0; repeated labels are separate sections).

style.description: intent / dsl: strum, arpeggio, rolled or sustain; grid: strum or arpeggio.

family.description: intent only: restrict to one family.

syncopationKinds.description: intent only: every listed kind is required. Anticipation ('食い') is within the measure; cross-bar chord anticipation is not generated.

preferredPresetId.description: intent only: a soft preference (used when it passes every hard filter).

difficulty.description: intent only: presets harder than this are excluded.

operation.description: intent only (required there). Relative requests (stronger, softer, more syncopated, for beginners) = adapt; family changes (make it 16-beat, arpeggio) = replace.

presetId.description: preset only: canonical preset id from guitardsl_analyze_accompaniment.

attacks.description: grid only: ascending unique 0-based slots that sound (4/4 eighth = 0..7, 4/4 sixteenth = 0..15, 4/4 tripletEighth = 0..11, 6/8 eighth = 0..5).

accents.description: grid only: subset of attacks with an accent.

ghosts.description: grid only: subset of attacks played as ghost strokes (strum only).

pattern.description: dsl only: GuitarDSL rhythm tokens of one full measure, e.g. '4.d 8.d 4.u 8.u 8.d 8.u'.

directionPolicy.description: dsl only. Default physical. Use literal only when the user explicitly asked for special stroke directions; never choose it on your own.

phraseLength.description: Phrase length in measures for phrase-end variations; omitted = 8/4/2 by the section's measure count.

arrangementGroup.description: Keeps repeated sections (e.g. every chorus) in the same family / style / subdivision.

arrangementRole.description: base = defines the group's preset; variation = a catalog variation of it; finale = same family, energy/density at most one step higher.

plans.description: Section plans; each sectionIndex at most once.

targetMeasureOffset.description: -1 = the section's last measure, -2 = the one before.

pattern.description: Structured pattern: {source:'preset', presetId} (full measures), {source:'grid', gridUnit, attacks, accents?, ghosts?} (0-based slots; the extension decides down/up and durations) or {source:'hold'} (hold the last stroke before the vocal-safe point to the measure end). Raw down/up tokens are not accepted.

attacks.description: Ascending unique slot indices that sound.

ghosts.description: Subset of attacks played as ghost (muted) strokes.

ending.description: Optional final-song ending for the last section's final 1-2 measures.

pattern.description: Structured pattern: {source:'preset', presetId} (full measures), {source:'grid', gridUnit, attacks, accents?, ghosts?} (0-based slots; the extension decides down/up and durations) or {source:'hold'} (hold the last stroke before the vocal-safe point to the measure end). Raw down/up tokens are not accepted.

attacks.description: Ascending unique slot indices that sound.

ghosts.description: Subset of attacks played as ghost (muted) strokes.

fermataFinal.description: Add a fermata to the final event.
